occurrences.text: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
